facts.text: The Dakota Corps program awards four-year full-tuition-and-fee scholarships to South Dakota seniors who agree to enter critical-need careers like education or nursing.

sources.title: Freshman Scholarships | Northern State University
sources.quote: The Dakota Corps scholarships are four-year, full-tuition-and-fee scholarships for South Dakota high school seniors who plan to major in and then become employed in one of the following critical-need occupations
